    payload = case['payload']
    threshold = payload['threshold']
    calls = payload['calls']
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        loss_without = call['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']
        tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        parseable = call['parseable']
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized_gain = gain / tokens
        normalized_gain_rounded = round(normalized_gain, 6)
        diagnostics.append({'call_id': call_id, 'normalized_gain': normalized_gain_rounded})
        if parseable and normalized_gain >= threshold:
            accepted.append(call_id)
    return {'accepted_call_ids': accepted, 'diagnostics': diagnostics}"}
